deep_dive.title: WaveMark: Robust Wavelet-Domain Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models
deep_dive.abstract: Image watermarking enables provenance tracing for photorealistic images generated by diffusion models. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) removal attacks can suppress embedded signals with little perceptual degradation. This vulnerability limits the effectiveness of watermarks for intellectual property protection and misuse attribution. We propose WaveMark, a novel wavelet-domain watermarking method that embeds messages in a diffusion model's initial noise. To support robust recovery from perturbed carriers, WaveMark distributes keyed replicas of message bits across spatial positions, wavelet orientations, and scales. Each carrier groups coefficients from four latent channels and encodes a randomized bit through magnitude projection, providing an explicit decoding margin. We evaluate WaveMark with SD2.1 on SDP and MS-COCO Captions under 14 attacks. WaveMark achieves 100.0% bit accuracy (BA) without attacks, while maintaining image quality comparable to the evaluated baselines. Under SOTA MarkNull and MarkNull-A, it retains over 88% BA, outperforming all baselines.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Image watermarking for diffusion model provenance is vulnerable to removal attacks; WaveMark embeds keyed message replicas in the initial noise across spatial positions, wavelet orientations and scales.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对扩散模型生成图像的来源追溯需求，现有水印易被先进移除攻击在几乎无感知退化的情况下抑制，限制了版权保护与滥用归因的有效性。论文提出WaveMark，一种小波域水印方法，将消息嵌入扩散模型的初始噪声中。为抵抗载体扰动，方法在空间位置、小波方向与尺度上分布带密钥的消息比特副本，每个载体组合四个潜通道系数并通过幅度投影编码随机比特。实验表明该方法能在移除攻击下更鲁棒地恢复水印，为扩散模型输出水印提供更可靠的方案。
